description: Check pricing for a country + service pair before ordering. Returns min, max, and suggested price, average quality score, and number of available phone numbers. Use this before order_number to verify cost and availability. Accepts country and service as human-readable names or IDs.

max_price.description: Optional budget limit in USD cents. A warning is shown if the suggested price exceeds this.

service.description: Service category name or ID from the Platfone catalog.

name: check_price
title: Check Price
